## Checklist

- [ ] I incremented `plugin.json.version` for a released plugin change.
- [ ] The registry ID, path, kind, and release flag are correct.
- [ ] `pnpm build`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm run pack`, and `pnpm release:verify` pass.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I did not commit credentials, `.env` files, build artifacts, or source maps.
- [ ] I documented new permissions, network origins, storage, and data retention.
- [ ] I signed the ClassroomIO Contributor License Agreement if this is my first contribution.
